paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption_used: Distribution of articles across the three-year collection period (2017-2019), displayed as a pie chart with percentage and count labels. The 2019 cohort (blue) represents the largest share at 46.0% (46 articles), followed by 2018 (orange) at 33.0% (33 articles) and 2017 (green) at 21.0% (21 articles). The distribution reflects a steady annual increase, with the 2018-to-2019 growth rate of approximately 25% exceeding the 2017-to-2018 growth rate of roughly 35%. The combined 2017-2018 corpus accounts for slightly over half of all articles at 54%, suggesting that the collection effort intensified primarily in the final year.

model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across three years – 2017, 2018, and 2019 – representing the number of articles included in a collection. The chart contains three slices, each representing a year, and includes a legend identifying the color associated with each year: 2017 is depicted in green, 2018 in orange, and 2019 in blue. The slice corresponding to 2019 covers approximately 46.0% of the total area and contains the numerical value of 46, while 2018 occupies roughly 33.0% with a count of 33, and 2017 represents approximately 21.0% with a count of 21. The segments appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm stellt die Verteilung von Artikeln über den Zeitraum der dreijährigen Sammlung von 2017 bis 2019 dar. Das Diagramm enthält drei Segmente: 2019 in blau, 2018 in orange und 2017 in grün. Das 2019-Segment macht 46,0 % der gesamten Artikel aus (46 Artikel), gefolgt vom 2018-Segment, das 33,0 % der Artikel ausmacht (33 Artikel), und dem 2017-Segment, das 21,0 % der Artikel ausmacht (21 Artikel).  Innerhalb jedes Segments sind Prozentangaben angezeigt, und die Segmente sind in der Reihenfolge ihres Prozentsatzes angeordnet, beginnend mit dem größten Anteil.
